description_en: Deletes department information maintained in Alibaba Business Travel
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可删除已经维护在阿里商旅的部门信息
name: DeleteDepartment

parameters.help_en:
The custom enterprise department ID.
Ensure that this parameter is correct to prevent accidental deletion
parameters.help_zh:
企业自定义部门 ID。
请确保本参数无误，否则会出现误删的情况
parameters.name: out_dept_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access credential.
When you call the operation over HTTP, append this parameter as a required parameter to the request URL. For more information about how to obtain the credential, refer to Enterprise access credential (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending the parameter, you can use `so_corp_token=value`, `dtb_corp_token=value`, or `corp_token=value`. Use `corp_token=value`
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
使用 HTTP 方式调用接口时需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，可以选择 `so_corp_token=value`、`dtb_corp_token=value` 以及 `corp_token=value` 任一写法，推荐使用 `corp_token=value`
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace ID of the request, which is typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
